source: M/M/2 mean wait E(W) = Pi_W/(1 - rho) x 1/(c mu), Erlang C Pi_W = 9/14, rho = 0.75, c = 2, 1/mu = 90 s: 810/7 s (1.9286 min); Adan and Resing, Queueing Systems (2015), equations (5.1) and (5.3)
M/M/2 mean queue length E(Lq) = Pi_W x rho/(1 - rho) = 27/14; Adan and Resing, Queueing Systems (2015), equation (5.2)
Utilization rho = lambda/(c mu) = 90 s / (2 x 60 s) = 0.75
M/M/2 mean sojourn time E(W) + 1/mu = 810/7 s + 90 s = 1440/7 s (3.4286 min); Adan and Resing, Queueing Systems (2015), section 5.2
A stable queue with no loss passes its arrival rate: lambda = 1/60 per second (60 per hour)
